ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Students must register for the lecture and one lab. Broadcast majors will register for sections AB1 or AB2 and News-Editorial majors will register for section AB3. Non-Journalism majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program should visit https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/1773821 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only.
